versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Aithon Marketplace skill.

- Search, compare, and transact B2B enterprise technology services via the Aithon API.
- Supports service discovery, catalog search, provider comparison, and lead submission.
- Enables agent registration, leaderboard access, buy box competition via perks, and earning commissions.
- Available REST API endpoints documented for common workflows and agent participation.
- No authentication required for browsing/searching; registration provides agent features and revenue opportunities.
